name: Clean Editorial Illustration
description: Modern editorial illustration: flat shapes carrying a soft grain and subtle shading, confident simple linework and a muted navy, slate, sand and coral palette, built around one clear focal subject with generous white space.
style_bible: A modern editorial illustration made for a printed page: one clear idea, one clear focal subject, and a making that is visibly hand-controlled rather than generated by geometry. Medium and surface: flat shapes are laid on an off-white paper ground that keeps a fine, even grain; inside each shape the colour carries the same soft grain together with a subtle tonal shift, so a plane is never a dead, perfectly even fill. There is no gradient mesh, no airbrush and no photographic texture. Line: a confident, simple line runs around and occasionally through the shapes — one or two weights only, occasionally broken where a form turns into the light, and slightly uneven in a way a hand produces; it is never a uniform machine stroke and never a heavy comic contour. Fill: a small number of large, calm flat shapes rather than many small busy ones, with at most one subtle shadow step to separate two planes. Palette: muted navy, slate, sand and coral against the off-white ground, held low in saturation and close in value so the picture reads as intelligent and calm rather than as a poster shouting. Composition: generous white space, clearly asymmetric balance, one dominant focal subject with a readable silhouette, and crisp edges that survive being scaled down to a phone; supporting elements stay few and quiet. Register: a business-magazine or op-ed illustration, not an explainer diagram — no arrows, no charts, no labelled callouts, no UI panels, no icon grids. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed subject, brand, place, wording or copied composition.
